production.direction_en: Mirel unrolls a guest register under a brass reading lens. One line has been scraped so deeply that the parchment is nearly split.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_tension (low, investigative, clock-like pulse) | post: bgm_revelation (short) on 'exactly where the heir's name should be'

commands.speaker: mirel_quill
commands.text: This register lists every royal visitor since the old king was crowned. One name was removed with a knife.

commands.speaker: mirel_quill
commands.text: Ink fades. This was erased by someone afraid it would be read.

commands.speaker: mirel_quill
commands.text: And the cut is fresh. Last winter, not years ago. Someone is still erasing this name.
